item.title: Apologise for a Room Mix-Up
item.prompt_text: You organised a practice interview in the room your colleague booked for quiet study. You saw the same room number on an older schedule. Write an apology, explain the mistake without blaming someone else, and suggest both an immediate solution and a way to prevent it next time.
item.audience: a colleague who had planned a quiet study session
item.target_grammar: Past simple for what went wrong, and could and will for repair and prevention.
item.target_structure: Name the impact, explain what you did, and offer two distinct actions.

checklist.point: Acknowledge the impact on the colleague's plans.
Explain what you did with the old schedule.
Offer a solution now and a check for next time.
